*PharmaCraft Daily - 07 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Autonomic Nervous System)
Q: The neurotransmitter at all autonomic ganglia is?
Ans: Acetylcholine
Why: Acetylcholine acts on nicotinic (Nn) receptors at both sympathetic and parasympathetic ganglia.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Sacubitril is combined with valsartan; it is a?
Ans: Neprilysin inhibitor
Why: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, raising natriuretic peptides. ARNI (sacubitril-valsartan) improves survival in HFrEF.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Ivabradine lowers heart rate by acting on?
Ans: Funny (If) current in SA node
Why: Ivabradine selectively inhibits the If current in the SA node, slowing heart rate without affecting contractility or BP.

🌍 *FMGE* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Statins lower cholesterol by inhibiting?
Ans: HMG-CoA reductase
Why: Statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme of cholesterol synthesis. Watch for myopathy and raised LFTs.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Clinical Trials)
Q: The gold-standard design to minimise bias in a clinical trial is?
Ans: Randomised double-blind controlled trial
Why: Randomisation and double-blinding minimise selection and observer bias, making the RCT the gold standard for efficacy.
